# Trust Law Partners

> > California inheritance dispute and trust litigation law firm specializing in will contests, fiduciary duty breaches, and beneficiary rights protection.

Trust Law Partners LLP serves California and Texas clients in complex estate disputes, trust contests, and probate litigation. The firm handles cases involving undue influence, elder abuse, wrongful disinheritance, and trustee accountability under California Probate Code.

## Key Topics

- Trust litigation
- Will contests
- Fiduciary duty
- Undue influence
- Beneficiary rights
- California Probate Code
- Estate disputes
- Trustee accountability
- Elder abuse
- Wrongful disinheritance
- Probate law
- No-contest clauses
- Trust administration
- Estate planning disputes
- Forensic accounting
